summary: PR-1300 removes the audit event from CaseService.markDocumentReceived, a state-changing operation, and replaces it with an application log line. This violates AUD-1 (every state change records an audit event), and no approved, unexpired exception covers AUD-1 for mortgage.cases. The process records are otherwise in order: an approved ticket, independent review on the head commit, and a green CI run. But the AUD-1 control test only samples operations and doesn't check this path, so the passing suite doesn't excuse the gap. The change is rejected.
